title: GojiberryAI Sales OS — 13-agent outbound stack on hosted MCP
summary: Open-source MIT sales department for Grok Bot and Claude Code: thirteen role agents from signal hunting through meeting qualification, coordinated via hosted GojiberryAI MCP endpoints and installable skills.
question_it_answers: What does a multi-agent outbound sales OS look like on a hosted MCP bus?

claims.text: The repo ships thirteen specialized outbound agents orchestrated through the GojiberryAI MCP.
claims.evidence: Thirteen specialized agents — signal hunting, ICP filtering, account research, enrichment, copywriting, LinkedIn outreach, reply handling, meeting qualification — coordinated via the hosted **GojiberryAI MCP**.
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents

claims.text: Cursor users can copy skills and point MCP at https://mcp.gojiberry.ai/mcp.
claims.evidence: Manual / Cursor: copy `skills/sales-os/` into agent skills; point MCP at `https://mcp.gojiberry.ai/mcp`.
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents

claims.text: GitHub API this pass: MIT, 96 stars, 22 forks, created 2026-09-01. Public External API is OpenAPI 3.0.0 at ext.gojiberry.ai/openapi.json (89,620 B, 32 paths).
